turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I've got a ten hour layover in Istanbul and I'm not sure what to do with it.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'll tell you all the choices first. Wait until I'm finished before you comment.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I could stay in the airport lounge, shower, nap and eat, nice and stress free.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Or take the metro into the old city, see a mosque or two and get back in time, hopefully.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: There's also a short guided tour the airline offers for transit passengers, about six hours with a guide.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, I'm done. What do you think?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Ten hours is enough to leave the airport, so I'd go for the airline tour, it handles the timing and the visa questions for you. Going alone is fine too if you're confident, just leave plenty of buffer. The lounge is good if you're exhausted.
